page.title: Batches
page.description: Run large sets of requests offline at batch priority: upload a JSONL file, follow the progress and download the results

action.cancelBody: Requests that have not started will not run. Requests already in flight may finish for up to 2 minutes before the batch is cancelled.

empty.all: No batches yet. Create one by uploading a JSONL file of requests.
empty.filtered: No batch matches the selected status.

detail.title: Batch {{id}}
detail.pendingHint: Requests the platform is retrying, for example while a deployment wakes, after a preemption by a higher-ranked deployment, or after a 429 or 5xx answer, are counted as not finished.

waiting.title: Requests are waiting to be retried

download.hint: The output and error files are deleted at {{time}}.
download.expired: This file has expired and was deleted.

detail.cancelPending: Cancel requested. The batch stays cancelling until the requests in flight end, up to 2 minutes.

create.title: Create batch
create.fileHelp: Choose a .jsonl file (JSON Lines), one request per line.

window.label: Completion window
window.help: A whole number of hours from {{min}} to {{max}}, {{default}} by default. Requests without a result by then are treated as expired.

model.label: Model
model.placeholder: Use the model on each line of the file
model.help: Optional. The default choices can serve or wake automatically. Show waiting models to choose one that is starting or needs recovery; its requests may wait until the batch expires. The chosen model replaces body.model on every line.

state.asleepHeld: asleep (held, requests do not wake it)

warning.asleepHeld: {{model}} sleeps by an operator's or a schedule's order, which requests do not wake: the batch's requests are retried until someone wakes it or the batch expires.
warning.offline: {{model}} runs on nodes that are not connected: the batch's requests are retried until a node returns or the batch expires.
warning.failed: {{model}}'s deployment failed to start: the batch's requests are retried until someone repairs it or the batch expires.
warning.stopped: {{model}}'s deployment is stopped: the batch's requests wait until someone starts it or the batch expires.

model.showWaiting: Show models that need to wait

fileModels.none: No model name was found in the file.
fileModels.skipped: The file is over 50 MB, so its models were not checked in the browser.
fileModels.unknown: These models in the file have no available deployment on the platform, so the batch cannot be created: {{models}}. Choose a model above to replace them, or deploy these models first.
fileModels.replaced: The models in the file ({{models}}) will all be replaced by {{model}}.

warnings.BATCH_MODEL_SLEEP_HELD: {{model}} sleeps by an operator's or a schedule's order, which requests do not wake: the batch's requests are retried until someone wakes it or the batch expires.
warnings.BATCH_FILE_MODELS_SLEEP_HELD: {{models, list}} in the file sleep by an operator's or a schedule's order, which requests do not wake: their requests are retried until someone wakes them or the batch expires.
warnings.BATCH_MODEL_WAITS: {{model}} is {{state}}: the batch's requests are retried until it serves or the batch expires.
warnings.BATCH_FILE_MODELS_WAIT: {{models, list}} in the file are {{state}}: their requests are retried until they serve or the batch expires.

hint.format: JSON Lines, at most {{size}} MB and {{requests, number}} requests.
hint.unique: custom_id must be unique within the file.
hint.sameUrl: All lines use the same url; the batch calls that endpoint.
hint.retention: The output and error files are kept for {{days}} days after the batch ends.

create.tooLarge: The file is larger than {{limit}} MB.

dictionary.loading: Reading what a batch can be created with...
dictionary.failed: Could not read what a batch can be created with

errors.fileLine: Line {{line}} of the file is not valid: {{reason}}

fileReasons.invalid_json_line: the line is not valid JSON
fileReasons.invalid_url: url is missing or not a supported endpoint
fileReasons.streaming_not_supported: streaming is not supported in a batch
fileReasons.too_many_requests: the file has more requests than a batch allows
fileReasons.upload_failed: the upload could not be read
fileReasons.mixed_endpoints: the url differs from the first line's; a batch calls one endpoint

requestReasons.endpoint_mismatch: the requests in the file do not all use the given endpoint
requestReasons.invalid_multipart: the upload is not a valid form

errors.requestInvalid: The batch request is not valid ({{field}}): {{reason}}

api.title: Call it through the API (OpenAI-compatible /v1/files and /v1/batches)
api.description: Batches are the platform's OpenAI Batch API: call the gateway directly with an API key, and the official OpenAI SDK only needs its base_url pointed here. This page is a management view of the same batches.

steps.sdk: Or with the OpenAI Python SDK
